conclusion: Organic model-root support can remain suspended on curved surfaces even when slicing succeeds. A reviewed X2 organic case with XY gap 0.4 and bottom Z gap 0.17 produces four roots about 0.95-1.05 mm above their first footprint/model intersection and two external disconnected interface islands. An XY-zero diagnostic restores approximately 0.174 mm model-root centerline gaps while external islands remain; bottom-Z-zero leaves approximately 0.84 mm root gaps. Current organic fallback contact retention does not require a valid placeable intersection, and collision-clipped area thresholds do not prove anchoring. Future repair needs landing and extrusion-level connectivity validation across devices; this entry records a reproduced unresolved defect, not a fix. CLI diagnostic overrides must be marked in different_settings_to_system and verified from emitted effective settings.
